question: In which book was a full account of Mordecai's greatness written?
options: The book of the annals of the kings of Media and Persia
The book of the annals of the kings of Judah
The book of the law of Moses
explanation: King Xerxes' acts and a full account of Mordecai's greatness were written in the book of the annals of the kings of Media and Persia.
